Class BugemonGridView

java.lang.Object
views.teamchoice.selection.BugemonGridSubView
public class BugemonGridView extends Object
Sub-view managing the Bugémon selection grid. Handles button display, hover popups and click-to-select logic. Included in selectionview.fxml via fx:include.
